question: Does any automated trading strategy published on the web, tested exactly as published, pass every gate below on free data?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-11, before any candidate was collected or viewed. The user asked to keep searching until a strategy passes all tests. Searching until something passes is a multiple-testing machine, so the gates, the trial budget and the deflated-Sharpe correction are fixed here and cannot be changed after candidates are seen.

scope.eligible: strategies with explicit, codable rules (entry, exit, sizing, universe, rebalance) published on the web (papers, quant blogs, bot repos, strategy libraries), testable on free daily or 8h data: Yahoo daily ETFs/indices/futures proxies, FRED series, and the repo's crypto loaders (MEXC, Binance, OKX, Bybit, Hyperliquid, Deribit DVOL)
scope.excluded: families already tested and failed in this repo: price-only strategy zoos (breakout, mean reversion, pairs, session/time-of-day effects, vol-managed momentum, high-vol breakout, 8h reversal), Fear & Greed sentiment, Kronos/foundation-model forecasts, FX/index trend on the repo's 20 ETFs, consolidation/regime diagnostics, funding carry; new trend variants on DON8/EMA8/VOL8 or the repo's 10 crypto coins; anything needing order-book replay, paid data or live order placement
scope.preference: evidence-rate rule: candidates that add independent breadth (assets outside the crypto factor) or a new information type are tested first

procedure.no_tuning: each candidate is coded once with the source's published parameters; if the source gives none, the candidate is ineligible. Bugs may be fixed only if a truncation (look-ahead) test or an accounting check fails, and the fix is logged
procedure.rounds: web research in rounds of up to 12 candidates; stop at the first candidate that passes every gate, or when the budget is spent, or after 4 rounds
procedure.ledger: every candidate tested is appended to research/strategy_search_v1/trials.jsonl with its daily return series hash; untested or ineligible candidates are logged with the reason

samples.development: the source's own sample period if stated (truncated to data availability), otherwise data start to 2019-12-31
samples.validation: 2020-01-01 to 2026-09-30 minus any part of the development sample; never used for anything but this gate
samples.costs: ETFs and index proxies 10 bps round trip; crypto 20 bps round trip plus the venue's own funding on held perp positions; FRED-based signals use only data published before the trade date (release lag 1 business day minimum)

gates.G1_truncation: signals at date t are identical when all data after t is removed (checked on 50 random dates)
gates.G2_development: net annualized Sharpe >= 0.5 and Newey-West t (5 lags) >= 2.0
gates.G3_validation: net annualized Sharpe >= 0.4, same sign as development, and validation Sharpe >= 40% of development Sharpe
gates.G4_matched_null: development mean return beats 999 action-matched random books (review_methods), empirical p <= 0.05
gates.G5_deflated_sharpe: deflated Sharpe probability >= 0.95 on the development sample, with the number of trials = every candidate tested so far in this search (cumulative, not per round) and the variance of their Sharpe ratios
gates.G6_robustness: every published parameter perturbed by +/-20% (one at a time): development Sharpe stays >= 50% of the published-parameter Sharpe in all perturbations; and positive Sharpe in both halves of the development sample
gates.G7_costs: cost wall (round trip at which mean net return reaches zero) >= 3 x the assumed cost
gates.G8_independence: daily return correlation with the repo's trend core (crypto-trend-core-v1 combined book) <= 0.5 over their overlap; for non-crypto candidates also <= 0.7 with SPY buy-and-hold

outcome.pass: a candidate passing G1-G8 is a promising prospect only: it is frozen and registered as a forward watch (descriptive until its own review). No promotion, no live trading.
outcome.no_pass: if the budget or rounds are exhausted, the search reports FAIL with the full trial ledger; it is not extended or rerun with looser gates
